I will label them R1‑R4 from left to right as requested and list their connections. 

- R1 = 45 Ω between B and N_b1  
- R2 = 35 Ω between B and N_b2  
- R3 = 20 Ω between B and N_b3  
- R4 = 5 Ω between N_b1 and X1
